subject: Music Production
title: Rick Rubin's Stripped-Down Sound
description: A quick, practical guide to Rick Rubin's Stripped-Down Sound.

hook.text: Rick Rubin co-founded Def Jam Records from his college dorm room at NYU in 1984.

buildup.text: While other hip-hop producers added layers, Rubin stripped beats down to bare drums and attitude.

discovery.text: His minimalist approach worked on rap, rock, and country, revealing the raw power of simplicity.

twist.text: Rubin rescued Johnny Cash's career by recording him alone with an acoustic guitar and his voice.

climax.text: From the Beastie Boys to Adele, Rubin's less-is-more philosophy reshaped multiple genres.

punchline.text: Taking sounds away made music more powerful.

quiz.question: What defined Rick Rubin's production philosophy?
options: Adding as many layers as possible
Stripping music down to its raw essentials
